issues.on_page: Allocation From General Fund 876,900.98 (Total Governmental Funds), = Depreciation Fund 850,000.00 (p8) + Employee Benefit Fund 26,900.98 (p9)
issues.issue: Hidden transfer recorded as revenue. The label itself says this is money moved from the General Fund to other governmental funds, so it is not a receipt from outside. Recording it as an 'other' receipt and also leaving the General Fund's matching outflow in spending counts the same 850,000 twice: once as General Fund spending (2730 Property, p29) and again when the Depreciation Fund spends it (Other Purchased Services 579,314.72 / Capital Outlay 358,932.72, p12). It should be a transfer in (transfers_in 125,450.00 + 876,900.98) with the General Fund side moved to transfers out. Caveat: the report itself does not eliminate it. Exhibit II (p7) includes it in 'Other' 1,002,529.08 = 876,900.98 + 125,628.10, and the extractor kept it as printed with a review note. The page does not show which General Fund line holds the 26,900.98 sent to the Employee Benefit Fund, so a contra line would be needed for that part.

issues.on_page: Vehicle Servicing & Maintenance - Regular Education 903,966.59; Schedule M (p29) shows it is Purchased Property Services 48,447.43 + Other Property Services 5,519.16 + Property 850,000.00
issues.issue: This line includes the 850,000.00 that went to the Depreciation Fund as 'Allocation From General Fund' (p8). That is a transfer recorded as student transportation spending. The spending part is 53,966.59; the 850,000.00 should be a split_from transfer out (with review), as the hidden-transfer rule describes. Only a review note was added.

issues.on_page: 2730 Vehicle Servicing & Maintenance - Regular Education: Property 850,000.00 (no budget)
issues.issue: This exactly matches the Depreciation Fund's 'Allocation From General Fund' 850,000.00 (p8), so it is an interfund transfer recorded as equipment spending. It should be an other financing line of -850,000.00 (split_from 2730 Property p29, review) and not an expenditure. The amount and label are as printed.

This is a broad group, not all property tax. Exhibit II moves at least 366,713.63 of it into program charges for services (53,469.93 + 19,690.00 on p2; Student Activities 293,553.70 on p4), and the Activities Fund local receipts are student activity receipts. It is left unsplit with a review note, which is acceptable, but the property tax figure is overstated.

issues.on_page: Other Purchased Services 970,051.57 (Depreciation 579,314.72 + Special Building 296,934.58 + QCPU 83,016.27 + Employee Benefit 9,900.00 + Student Fee 886.00)
issues.issue: The category is a guess. The label is an object, not a function, and part of it (Employee Benefit, Student Fee) is clearly not capital outlay.

Principal and interest are not split on the page. The 1,300,000.00 is a payment to the component unit (Educational Facilities Leasing Corporation), which reports the same 1,300,000.00 as its own debt service (p6-7).

This does not match the basic statement. disbursements[38] 'State Programs' (19,557.82, which includes this 6,208.42) is categorized as instruction. The same money gets different functions in the two series.
In Operation of Buildings, 'Supplies' probably includes energy/utilities (the extractor flagged this for review). It may belong under utilities (power, gas, phone).

This object mapping is an assumption applied to every 'Other Property Services' line, e.g. 1200 Special Education 527,033.76 (p21) and 6408 IDEA 167,033.47 (p30). In the Nebraska school chart of accounts this is probably the 500-series 'Other Purchased Services' (tuition/contracted services, transportation, communication, travel). Likewise 'Other Items' was mapped to dues, training and travel throughout. Both are defensible guesses, not printed categories.
